model.requirement: One open-weight video model generates the edited pixels directly. Inference scripts are permitted. One attempt, fixed settings/seed across duration-limited segments; log every segment and technical retry.
model.examples: Use an open-weight video model your hardware supports, for example MiniMax-H3 (MiniMax, 2026, https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3), JoyAI-Video-Edit (JD Open Source, 2026, https://github.com/jd-opensource/JoyAI-Video-Edit), LTX-2.3 (Lightricks, 2026, in/outpainting IC-LoRA) or Wan2.1-VACE-14B (Wan, arXiv:2503.20314; VACE, Jiang et al., arXiv:2503.07598); other open-weight models are equally welcome. Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B (Apache 2.0) is a smaller option; memory depends on settings (staff trial: 14 GB, 13 min for a 5.5 s cut at 480p, mask + reference image). The staff example with MiniMax-H3 is in data/genai_oracle/.
model.name: Wan-AI/Wan2.1-VACE-14B-diffusers

interval.note: The entire normalised personal clip, inclusive source frames 0-449 (15 seconds at 30 fps). Inputs must use the original source indices. All preselected comparison frames are covered; no source video or audit annotation is modified.

model.notes: A100 40-GB memory-conscious plan, not GPU-benchmarked: three contiguous 5-second source intervals, source frames 0-149,150-299,300-449. Each uses the same official checkpoint revision, short prompt, seed 2026, 832x480, 16 fps, 50 steps, guidance 5, conditioning 1, UniPC flow shift 3, BF16 with VAE FP32, VAE tiling and sequential CPU offload. Each raw output has 81 frames; preserve it unchanged and retain only indices 0-79 for the final concatenation. The predeclared last padding frame is excluded, giving exactly 240 frames at 16 fps (15 seconds), without retiming, crossfades, geometric correction or classical background compositing. Temporal pair 390-391 stays inside the last segment and maps to joined indices 208-209. Record every segment and unchanged-settings technical retry in genai_log.csv. No generation has run.
